title: This phone's Android version isn't one this release knows
body: No build in the release's list of Google's builds has both this phone's bootloader (fake-7.7) and its baseband (fake-radio-7.7). The installer uses a build only when both match and the release was tested with it; there is no nearest build.
If Android offers an update, install it (Settings > System > System update) and start the installer again.
After an Android update, Android runs from slot B and the two bootloader copies can differ; the installer then stops for that, and the install guide has the way to put Android back on slot A.
If Android is up to date, its build is newer than this release knows. Open an issue so it can be added: https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Start the installer again once that is done.
